Flow.description: 2026-09-10 (LFRDN discount-price bug): Tier 0 (self-authorized, <=2%) discounts never enter AF_AP_Quote_DiscountTiers at all - AF_FL_Quote_SetDiscountApprovalStatus (before-save) sets AF_DiscountApprovalStatus__c straight to Not Required without ever going Pending, so AF_FL_Quote_DiscountApproved (which only fires on the transition to Approved) never runs for this case, and Grand Total silently never reflected the discount even though Discount Amount/Discount % displayed correctly. This flow covers exactly that gap: fires only on the transition INTO Not Required, looks up the Quote's Vehicle line item (AF_LineItemType__c=Vehicle) and writes Quote.AF_DiscountPercent__c onto its native Discount (Percent) field, same mechanism AF_FL_Quote_DiscountApproved uses for the Approved case - Salesforce recalculates TotalPrice/Subtotal from Discount automatically. If the Quote has no Vehicle line, silently no-ops. Deliberately a separate flow from AF_FL_Quote_DiscountApproved rather than widening that one's trigger, since Tier 0 was never actually submitted for approval and that flow's own notification text ("your discount request has been approved") would be factually wrong for a self-authorized discount nobody reviewed.
Flow.label: Quote Apply Self-Authorized Discount
